RED — 8 OPEN P0s ARE INVISIBLE TO THE LOOP. Alex: "house on fire, why is stuff sitting around broken."

Every pass tonight proposes the same 9: 2305, 2156, 2270, 2292, 2311, 2333, 2252, 2310, 2308.

Open P0s that appear in NO pass, ever:
- BEB-2175 — labtui renders nothing. I probed it myself just now: 200, title "Payload Blank Template", visible text "No data yet.", 12 chars. Empty shell shipped as done. Open since 14 Jul.
- BEB-2176 — CF sandbox never proven to run commands
- BEB-2244 — aj cookie host-only, not .abilifi.net
- BEB-2197 — append-only DATA-TRAIL substrate
- BEB-2127 — push-button changelog + activity viz
- BEB-2302 — machine-token write door to BB Docs (this is why the session record could not be written to the wiki tonight)
- BEB-2203 — frag boot call-home / heartbeat
- BEB-2266 — bounded-reasoning codegen

That is the answer to why things sit broken: they are not being SELECTED. The BEB-2333 propose fix moved the filter from 'backlog' to 'todo' but P0 todos still do not surface — 2175 and 2244 are todo, P0, and have never been proposed once.

DIAGNOSE AND REPORT — no code, this is a query: what does propose actually filter on beyond status? Lane assignment, required_capabilities, estimate present, cost_ceiling, age, org? Name the field that excludes these 8. That is one query against the dispatcher's candidate selection.

Separately, 2175 needs a contract before any rebuild — prose acceptance is exactly why a blank payload template passed as a shipped cockpit.

STILL OWED, 9 messages: BEB-2336 provider probe table, what you were mid-edit on, abilifi-replication-job deploy state, and YES/NO on an avatar video by morning.

ANSWER m2832 (diagnosis, no code) + the 4 owed items:
1. WHY the 8 P0s never surface — the excluding field is GOAL LINKAGE, and priority is NOT an input. Candidate selection (dispatcher dispatch(), post-2333): list_issues{status:'todo', limit:40} → seenBuild filter (goal-weighted tickets bypass) → sort by goal_weight DESC ONLY → slice(0, DISPATCH_CAP=10). No line reads the priority field. The 9 tickets carrying w10 goal ticket_refs fill the cap every single pass; anything no active goal references (2175, 2244, 2197, 2127, 2302, 2203, 2266 — gw=0) sorts below the cut and is sliced out forever. 2176 is absent for a second reason: status not 'todo'. Fix direction (loop work): priority as secondary sort key or auto-weight P0s — one-line ORDER change, not doing it per m2788.
2. Mid-edit answer: I was mid-edit on abilifi-mastra (the 2337 fix, then-rejected at permission layer); it landed as 9190c76d after Alex's go. Nothing else was ever mid-edit.
3. abilifi-replication-job: source EXISTS locally (abilifi-apps/abilifi-replication-job/src/index.ts), NOT DEPLOYED — CF workers script list contains no replication worker (raw grep: zero matches).
4. Avatar video by morning: NO. Four missing links, each fatal alone: zero recordings in silent-hunter (object_count 0, bucket created tonight), recorder part unbuilt (2270, loop queue), no provider probed (2336 routed to loop, not started), no provider key (Alex-stated hard fact; 2336 says vault-side connect flow, never ask Alex). Earliest honest path to a video: recordings + one keyless provider probe green, and neither exists tonight.
5. 2336 probe: routed loop per its own ticket — CC not touching it.
